title: Stage 1 – Recruitment core
description: Player database, data imports, comparisons, scouting reports, shortlists, lightweight squad view.

title: Stage 2 – Video and match evidence
description: Video tagging, clip creation, event-linked statistics, tactical reports.

title: Stage 3 – Connected decisions
description: Tactical-fit recommendations, performance forecasts, budget scenarios.

title: Stage 4 – Development and availability
description: Training loads, player development, workload alerts and risk indicators (decision support for qualified staff).

title: Stage 5 – Squad operations
description: Attendance, contracts, staff workflows, academy administration.

title: Stage 6 – Commercial operations
description: Stadium income, sponsorships, advertising inventory, deals, executive financial planning.

title: Stage 7 – Additional sports
description: Further sport-specific engines on the shared foundation.
